The lady doctor had cancer diagnosed for me, with an immediate blood test, I’ve nothing but praise.
I very rarely attend the surgery.
I had a call from the surgery on Monday & I also had a call on the 31st September, which was a Sunday, I thought that was unusual. I’ve just had that information dismissed by a receptionist as false. I have a visual record of the calls from the surgery. I’m not a liar.
My neice has also been spoken to, less than kindly.
If we must be polite to the receptionists, that must then be reciprocal.
Give me the job, I will do it, with good nature & a helpful attitude. I’ve given 5* for the doctors only. Minus 3 for the patient
